items.title: A quantitative lower bound for the boundary function over the whole range of set sizes
items.author: Sahar Diskin, Anna Geisler
items.work: \vspace{-1.5cm}Perfect Matching in Product Graphs\\ and in their Random Subgraphs
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the quantitative boundary bound used in the Tutte-obstruction estimates (author lemma at source lines 811-816, label lem:strong-boundary, whose statement carries the author's own labelled display eq:strong-3d). The proof (source lines 818-838) splits the range of the size parameter into three pieces and in each piece evaluates the two available estimates on the boundary function, checking the numerical inequalities explicitly; the large range additionally uses the bound on p_- (proof lines 827-835). The range split and the arithmetic are the content. H2.
